name: BIMATOPROST 0.3MG/1ML 3ML OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION 1 PIECE
description: Bimatoprost 0.3 mg/ml ophthalmic solution in a 3 ml presentation is a prescription medication used to treat ocular hypertension and chronic open-angle glaucoma. It may also be indicated for eyelash growth. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
